title: MamMA: A Mamba-Based Pedestrian Trajectory Prediction Algorithm Considering Occupancy Map and Pedestrian Awareness States
abstract: arXiv:2609.08041v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Many pedestrian trajectory prediction algorithms have been proposed to improve the safety of navigation for mobile robots working in human-robot coexistence environments. Some pedestrian trajectory prediction algorithms extract information about obstacles near pedestrians from top-down view images to improve the accuracy of trajectory prediction. However, mobile robots typically create local occupancy maps using LiDAR, rather than top-down view images. Meanwhile, the vision sensors on board robots provide egocentric view images, which contain fine-grained behavioral information about the pedestrians near the robot. To better use the information collected by LiDAR and on-board vision sensors, we propose MamMA, a Mamba-based pedestrian trajectory prediction algorithm considering occupancy maps and pedestrian awareness states. MamMA divides the occupancy map by patches and extracts obstacle features from each patch to create map features.

translated_title: MamMA：一种考虑占据地图和行人感知状态的基于Mamba的行人轨迹预测算法
translated_abstract: 许多行人轨迹预测算法被提出来改善在人机共存环境中工作的移动机器人的导航安全性。一些行人轨迹预测算法从俯视图图像中提取行人附近障碍物的信息，以提高轨迹预测的准确性。然而，移动机器人通常使用激光雷达（LiDAR）创建局部占据地图，而非俯视图图像。同时，机器人上搭载的视觉传感器提供以机器人为中心的自我视角图像，其中包含机器人附近行人的细粒度行为信息。为了更好地利用激光雷达和机载视觉传感器收集的信息，我们提出了MamMA，一种考虑占据地图和行人感知状态的基于Mamba的行人轨迹预测算法。MamMA将占据地图按补丁划分，并从每个补丁中提取障碍物特征以构建地图特征。
tldr: 提出了MamMA，一种基于Mamba的行人轨迹预测算法，通过将占据地图按补丁划分提取障碍物特征，并结合行人感知状态和自我视角图像的细粒度行为信息，提升了人机共存环境中移动机器人的轨迹预测精度与导航安全性。
en_tdlr: MamMA is proposed as a Mamba-based pedestrian trajectory prediction algorithm that extracts obstacle features from patch-divided occupancy maps and incorporates pedestrian awareness states with fine-grained egocentric view information, improving trajectory prediction accuracy and navigation safety for mobile robots in human-robot coexistence environments.
